method: Evidence-based regeneration. API rows re-extract the pinned upstream route decorators and classify them from voicebridge.hermes_compat.match disposition plus the handler's real behaviour (a handler whose normal exits are typed gates/refusals is GATED; a real read/write is IMPLEMENTED; a wire-shape stub is PARTIAL). IMPLEMENTED additionally requires an on-disk tests/ function that dispatches the route, calls the handler, or calls the same downstream production module (AST scan), so no row is IMPLEMENTED on a phantom caller. cli / cli-subcommand rows derive status from the live voicebridge.cli build_parser tree plus voicebridge.cli_hermes_forward.FORWARD_TABLE and an AST scan of tests/ for the exercising caller. Plugin-fleet rows are declared explicitly and are IMPLEMENTED only when tests/test_hermes_plugins.py dispatches the registered compat handler over real local state. The full vendored plugin fleet is audited from voicebridge.hermes_plugins.plugin_fleet_audit (which plugin ships a dashboard/manifest.json) and embedded as the plugin_fleet metadata. No status is hand-flipped.

Real backend in voicebridge/hermes_plugins.py: reuses the vendored achievement engine + hermes_state.SessionDB over the local session history, persists snapshot/checkpoint/unlock state under the Qubit state dir (0600), serves /achievements (full unlocked/discovered/secret + tier wire shape), /scan-status (lifecycle), /recent-unlocks, /sessions/{id}/badges, /rescan (bounded by QUBIT_ACHIEVEMENTS_SCAN_LIMIT) and a confirm-gated /reset-state. Dashboard-only by design: the vendored plugin ships no CLI/voice surface and Qubit invents none. The plugin JS bundle is served by the webui overlay path, not this compat backend.

Real read API in voicebridge/hermes_plugins.py backed by the vendored hermes_cli.kanban_db (board/tasks incl. comments+links/boards/config/projects/workers/diagnostics/model-options/home-channels). The existing CLI and voice surfaces (`qubit kanban`, voice kanban_*) reach the same local backend. Task mutations are a typed policy gate, tracked separately as plugin:kanban-write-gate.

rows.capability: hermes dashboard plugin kanban write surface (typed gate)
rows.note: Every pinned kanban write route (create/patch/delete/bulk task, comments, links, boards CRUD/transfer/switch, dispatch, reclaim/reassign/specify/decompose, estimate, home-subscribe, run terminate, profile describe) resolves to the shared KANBAN_WRITE_BROKERED confirmation/broker gate; nothing is served as a direct dashboard write. The CLI/voice counterpart is `qubit kanban` + the pending-approvals banner.

rows.capability: hermes dashboard plugin kanban auxiliary reads (routes pending)
rows.note: Honest open row: the pinned plugin_api.py also serves GET /tasks/{id}/attachments, /attachments/{id} (binary download), /tasks/{id}/log, /runs/{id}, /runs/{id}/inspect, /profiles and GET/PUT /orchestration. The Qubit compat table routes the required kanban read surfaces (board/tasks/comments/links/boards/config/projects/workers/diagnostics/model-options/home-channels) and gates every write, but these auxiliary reads are not yet registered, so they 404 rather than fabricate. Route wiring lives in voicebridge/hermes_compat.py (not this module).

GET /api/dashboard/plugins/fleet returns the vendored plugin manifests (source=vendored) additively; the fixed ten-plugin overlay response at /api/dashboard/plugins is unchanged. Dashboard-only discovery surface: no CLI/voice command reads the vendored fleet. The full vendored fleet audit (which plugins declare a dashboard surface) is recorded in the section plugin_fleet metadata.
